runs.quote: Dates should be formatted as "Mon DD, YYYY"
runs.why: DD in date formatting conventions universally means a zero-padded two-digit day (01-31), so 'Jan 01, 2024' not 'Jan 1, 2024'
The example shows a single product with quantity 3 resulting in '3 items', so items count is the sum of all quantities, not the number of product lines
